Name: AT More Wood Fences
Author: IndigoShard
Description:
This is my first-ever mod and my entry into the Stardew Valley Modfest. I have been playing Stardew Valley since 2024 and fell in love with it. Thanks to orichufrogu and her amazing tutorial, I have been able to make this mod.
Ever been bored with the generic wood fence in your favorite game? Be bored no more and enjoy a fence that finally matches your Stardew Valley aesthetic.

This mod takes inspiration from Minecraft's multiple wood types and gives you a choice of what you want. I did not do Dark oak because that is kinda what we already have and I have a busy week coming up and wanted bamboo to get some extra attention.

Adding:

Oak

Spruce

Birch

Jungle

Pale Oak

Acacia(don't know who wants this)

Cherry

Crimson

Warped

and Mangrove

Manifest.Name: (AT) More Wood Fences
Manifest.Description: Adding the various wood types of Minecraft to the generic fence.
